task.title: Complete every owned mount teardown despite individual failures
task.problem: Unmount/removal failures can skip later mounts, child reaping or stream cleanup.
task.proposal: Isolate each teardown, reap each owned child and guarantee stream cleanup.
acceptance: Failure on the first mount does not skip later mounts.
Failed unmount still reaps the child; live retained mounts are reported.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.
